answer_text: Yes, by its own account. Deichmann says unauthorised persons got into selected customer data from its online shop, such as names, addresses, invoices and email addresses. It says passwords and card or PayPal details were not affected.

question_text: Were Deichmann customers' credit card or PayPal details stolen?
answer_text: Deichmann says no: card numbers, PayPal logins, passwords and account logins were not affected. Which payment method a customer chose may have been exposed.
label: Reported

question_text: Which Deichmann shops are affected, and is Snipes affected too?
answer_text: Deichmann has posted notices for its German, UK and Austrian online shops. dpa reports that its subsidiary Snipes is also affected. Whether shops in other countries are affected has not been said.
label: Reported

question_text: How many Deichmann customers are affected, and when did it happen?
what_would_settle_it: Deichmann, Snipes or a data protection authority giving a number of affected customers and the dates of the access.

question_text: Who was behind the Deichmann breach?
what_would_settle_it: Deichmann, investigators or prosecutors naming who was responsible, or a credible outlet reporting a claim of responsibility.
